Outstanding play by Elias Pettersson to knock down the puck and slip it back between his legs, even if he got knocked down in the process. 

Nice awareness by Linus Karlsson to jump on the loose puck and rifle it in. #Canucks

Two games for Chytil, two assists. 

Great setup for Öhgren, then retrieves the puck for Cotter to relay to Karlsson for the slap shot. #Canucks
